This suggests that Pongachalconel may be involved in the activation or modulation of this channel through the action of these compounds. The consistent scores across the three paths (final_score=0.783) indicate a strong level of confidence in the observed relationships, though the exact mechanism by which Pongachalconel influences the channel remains to be elucidated. The evidence supports a plausible pathway where Pongachalconel serves as a mediator in the interaction between the compounds and the potassium channel, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm this hypothesis.
